description: Search Threads agent tool - allows agents to query past conversation context

userStories.title: Create search_threads tool function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a LangChain tool that performs semantic search over past threads.
acceptanceCriteria: Create backend/src/tools/thread_search.py with @tool decorated search_threads function
Tool accepts query (str) and optional limit (int, default 5) parameters
Tool uses RunnableConfig to get user_id from config
Tool calls thread_snapshot_repo.search() same as /threads/search/semantic endpoint
Tool returns formatted results: thread_id, title, excerpt, score
Export as THREAD_SEARCH_TOOLS list
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow pattern from backend/src/tools/memory.py for RunnableConfig usage

userStories.title: Register tool in platform tools system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need search_threads registered in the platform tools list.
acceptanceCriteria: Add THREAD_SEARCH_TOOLS import to backend/src/utils/tools.py
Add matching condition in resolve_tool() for the new tool
Tool appears in /tools list endpoint response
Tool name is search_threads matching pattern of existing tools
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow pattern of SEARCH_TOOLS, FINANCE_TOOLS in utils/tools.py

userStories.title: Wire tool to use ServiceContext for DB access
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the tool to access the database through the proper service layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool receives store/checkpointer via RunnableConfig metadata or context
Uses ServiceContext pattern consistent with other tools
Handles errors gracefully
Works with existing tool injection pipeline in construct_agent()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add tool to frontend platform tools display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see and select search_threads in ToolSelectionModal.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool appears in PlatformToolsPanel when fetching tools
Tool has appropriate name, description, and tags
Tool can be toggled on/off like other platform tools
Selected tool is sent to backend with chat submissions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Verify workspace is clean and push final changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and pushed.
acceptanceCriteria: Run git status to check for uncommitted changes
If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch
All commits visible in GitHub PR
